rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a group selected to hear and decide a court case.

example.english: The jury will decide this case.
example.jyutping: ne1 daan1 on3 jau4 pui4 sam2 tyun4 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this for the panel of judges who assess a competition rather than a court case.

example.english: The jury for this singing competition is very strict.
example.traditional: 今次歌唱比賽嘅評判團好嚴格。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go1 coeng3 bei2 coi3 ge3 ping4 pun3 tyun4 hou2 jim4 gaak3
